openQuestions: Does phase 26 mean ONE thing or THREE? Sixteen §6 rows expect 'fix the Figma frames', §6 row 88(أ) expects 'run the Playwright MCP round for six phases', and Phase_18.md §4 expects 'visual comparison against eleven frames'. §9 splits 26 into 26أ (Figma correction) and 26ب (comparison and documentation), but the register's rows do not consistently say which part they mean. If 26أ is scoped only to editing Figma, six phases' worth of deferred visual verification has no home.

Who owns the three Phase_14 §4 items literally marked 'لا رقم مرحلة مُسنَد' (element/area palette sources, readMethod:'css', the replace trigger)? They are invisible to any plan that only re-sequences the existing 28 phases. §6 row 80 already documented this exact failure mode once — a promise falling between two closed phases because no row and no phase file inherited it.

§6 row 97 says the guard level's intermittency has a suspected common environmental cause that 'لم يُحسم بعد', and separately that measure, picker and popup fail LOCALLY too. Are those three genuinely three independent product defects, or three symptoms of the same unfound cause? Nobody has diagnosed them, and the answer changes whether this is a small fix or a phase-sized investigation.

Should §6 row 10 (the --rasd-text-tertiary AA contrast failure) be pulled forward ahead of the MVP gate? It is a shipped accessibility defect in 67 places, blocked only on a design decision in a phase that has never started, and phase 25 will re-discover it independently.

What is the actual status of task_1914c849 (the row-72 Icon.tsx spawn)? Its output exists uncommitted in a stale worktree. Was it abandoned, or is it waiting on something? The same question applies to whatever produced the Card.tsx change alongside it.

Phase_18.md §4 item 1 says search does not cover 'الملاحظات' because no note field exists on CaptureRecord and no phase owns one, and does not cover 'أسماء المشاريع' even though §10.4 names them. Is the fix to search.ts, or to §10.4? One of the two documents is wrong and the register has no row for it.

Does the `offscreen` permission survive to the store listing? src/offscreen/index.html:21 says its fate is decided in phase 25, but src/shared/permission-policy.ts:62 says permanent-permission justifications are copied verbatim into the Chrome Web Store submission in phase 27. Shipping a justification for a permission with no consumer is the kind of thing §6 row 19 already had to correct once.

§6 row 81 diagnosed the project's structural weakness as 'الأعطال تُكتشَف ولا تُمنَع' and rows 82/83 built two Constitution guards in response. Row 97 then found the whole guard level non-blocking. Is a third guard needed — one that asserts guards actually block — or is that a process rule rather than a script?
